## Foreman run, 2026-10-31 12:00

**What's running:** the CPU limit is the bottleneck. This account uses 28.0 of its 32 allowed cores (26.8 before my change); CPU time was cut short in 22 % of scheduling periods. The old FEBio queue has 9 runs going (physrotFr: p048, p060, p062, p109, p115, and p125 on CPU only; physrotV: p051, p082, p093) and 2 waiting (physrotV p036 and p113, the oldest queued 22 minutes ago). Runs finished per hour were 7, 6 and 5 for hours 09–11, none with a nonzero exit code. The new task queue is empty; its 5 gate2_* tasks have been failed since 10-28.

**Memory, disk and GPUs:** memory use shows 137.3 of 137.4 GB, but only 27.6 GB is real program memory (anon); the rest is reclaimable file cache, and out-of-memory kills are still at 2. /raid has 682 GB free. GPU3 is completely idle. GPU1 holds 5 of my runs plus another user's job and peaks at 100 %.

**Health:** no runs are dead or hung, and every service in `ops/resume_all.sh` is up. The 4 physrotU runs marked "exit=?" after the 10:58 scheduler restart all finished 6/6 sub-cases normally.

**What I changed:**
- **Fixed one slow run.** physrotV_p093 had been running on about 1 core instead of 4 for roughly 20 minutes. Its cores (7-9, 36) overlapped those given to p082 at 11:46. I moved p093 and its two parent processes to idle cores 37–40 with `taskset`, without restarting anything. p093 went from 100 % to 354 % CPU, and p082 is at 283 %.
- **No scheduler constants changed.** The CPU limit is the bottleneck and only 2 runs wait, so allowing more runs wouldn't help much. Changing a constant means restarting the scheduler, which is currently unsafe (below).

**Restart gap (not fixed, outside my scope):** after a scheduler restart, h19 finds running jobs by their working directory. It misses CPU-only split runs like p125, whose working directory is `case/w_*`. A restart now would mark p125 as ended while it is still running, and the watchdog could then start a duplicate in the same folder. I won't restart `biocage_sched` while p125 runs.

**Needs a person** (all are code changes outside my allowed edits):
1. In h06 `claimed_cores()`, count the cores of all live runs, not only recently started ones. This is the cause of the p093 overlap.
2. In h19, make the restart check also recognise working directories under `case/`.
3. In h19, prefer GPUs with fewer of my runs, so new runs go to the empty GPU3 rather than GPU1.
4. Queue the next work before about 13:00; the queue will empty in about an hour.
5. Decide what to do with the 5 failed gate2_* tasks, physrot2_p001 and zz_mc_c0.1_tied.

I also saved a memory note on the core-overlap fix and the restart rule for future runs.
